name: 2-in-1 Misting Hair Brush with Water Spray Bottle | Fine Mist Detangling Brush for Curly, Wavy & Straight Hair | Wet & Dry Styling Brush | Portable Anti-Frizz Hair Comb
description:
Refresh, detangle, and style your hair with this 2-in-1 Misting Hair Brush with Built-in Water Spray. Designed with an integrated fine-mist reservoir, the brush lightly moisturizes hair while brushing, helping make stubborn knots easier to manage and providing a smoother styling experience. Suitable for curly, thick, wavy, straight, and fine hair, this multifunctional brush can be used for everyday styling, refreshing curls, controlling frizz, and quick touch-ups. Its lightweight and portable design makes it convenient to carry in your handbag, gym bag, or travel kit. The built-in spray function helps distribute a fine mist evenly across the hair, while the detangling bristles glide through hair for convenient wet or dry styling.

Key Features
2-in-1 hair brush with built-in water spray mister
Fine mist helps moisturize hair while brushing
Detangling bristles designed for smooth and comfortable brushing
Suitable for curly, thick, wavy, straight, and fine hair
Helps manage tangles and reduce styling friction
Useful for refreshing curls and controlling frizz
Can be used for wet and dry hair styling
Refillable spray reservoir for convenient daily use
Lightweight and portable design for travel and on-the-go touch-ups
Leak-resistant design when properly closed
Suitable for women and girls

Product Specifications
Product Type: Misting Hair Brush / Detangling Brush
Design: 2-in-1 Hair Brush with Water Spray
Function: Detangling, Moisturizing & Hair Styling
Spray Type: Fine Mist
Suitable Hair Types: Curly, Wavy, Straight, Thick & Fine
Usage: Wet & Dry Hair
Suitable For: Women & Girls

How to Use
Open the spray reservoir and fill it with clean water
Close the reservoir securely before use
Gently press or activate the mist function to spray a fine mist onto the hair
Start brushing from the hair ends and gradually move upward
Continue brushing gently until the hair is detangled
Use for quick styling or refreshing throughout the day
Empty and clean the reservoir regularly

Material / Composition
Durable Hair Brush Body
Bristle & Nylon Detangling Teeth
Built-in Water Reservoir
Fine Mist Spray Mechanism

Safety Information
Use clean water in the spray reservoir
If using leave-in conditioner, ensure it is properly diluted and suitable for spray use
Do not use thick oils or undiluted liquids in the reservoir
Keep the brush clean and dry when not in use
Close the reservoir properly before placing it inside a bag
Avoid spraying directly into the eyes
Keep away from excessive heat and direct flames

Package Includes
1 × 2-in-1 Misting Hair Brush with Built-in Water Spray
